prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent pixel-art weapon asset for a retro tactical RPG.
Input 1 is the requested weapon silhouette/reference. Input 2 is supporting character art style only.
Create ONE isolated medieval KNIGHT JOUSTING LANCE, horizontal, sharp tip pointing LEFT, small pommel on the RIGHT, perfectly straight central axis. Genuine transparent background. No hands, character, ground shadow, sparkles, glows, labels or additional objects.
The weapon must clearly be the jousting lance in reference 1, NOT a narrow wooden spear with a leaf-shaped spearhead. A long pale ivory/steel CONICAL tapered front body widening continuously toward the grip. A visibly broad brass/gold bell-shaped curved open hand guard at its base, a slim short wrapped brown grip, and round/brass pommel at far right. Flat restrained ivory steel facets and subdued brass; dark blue-black crisp pixel outline like input2. Gold is a structural fitting, not glitter.
Geometry: whole lance length 208 normalized units. Sharp tip x0; long conical front body widens to x104. Broad flared bell handguard around x108, width about32 units, some open negative spaces. Gripping center x124. Wrapped rear handle spans x116..200, round metal pommel ends x208. Grip must remain narrow enough for an armored hand; front cone must NOT turn into a leaf, sword blade or polearm spike. One continuous intact weapon, no detached floating pieces. 2D game side-view, no perspective foreshortening. Render large enough for clean game asset downsampling, deliberate crisp stepped clusters, no background texture, no soft painterly antialiasing, no glossy bloom.
Keep body design from input1's long taper, bell guard and pommel, simplify ornamental cutouts for a readable 64px map and208px battle weapon.
